@@ -395,6 +395,92 @@ from ansible.utils.path import unfrackpath, makedirs_safe
 
 display = Display()
 
+_CLIXML_HEADER_FIND = re.compile(rb"(?<![^\r\n])(?:#< |<# )?CLIXML\r\n")
+
+
+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace embedded PowerShell CLIXML blocks in stderr with their text."""
+    output = bytearray()
+    offset = 0
+    search_offset = 0
+    changed = False
+
+    # CLIXML headers are line based, but its XML payload may span any number of
+    # lines and may share a line with ordinary stderr before or after the block.
+    while True:
+        header_match = _CLIXML_HEADER_FIND.search(stderr, search_offset)
+        if not header_match:
+            break
+
+        block_start = header_match.start()
+        xml_start = stderr.find(b"<Objs", header_match.end())
+        if xml_start == -1:
+            break
+
+        closing_tag = b"</Objs>"
+        block_end = stderr.find(closing_tag, xml_start)
+        if block_end == -1:
+            break
+
+        next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER_FIND.search(stderr, xml_start)
+        if next_header and next_header.start() < block_end:
+            next_xml = stderr.find(b"<Objs", next_header.end(), block_end)
+            if next_xml != -1:
+                # An unfinished block must not consume the end tag of a later
+                # independent block. A header string inside XML text is not a
+                # boundary unless another serialized root follows it.
+                search_offset = next_header.start()
+                continue
+
+        block_end += len(closing_tag)
+
+        # _parse_clixml can extract multiple adjacent Objs roots. Include them
+        # in one parse while stopping before any trailing non-CLIXML output.
+        while True:
+            next_root = block_end
+            while stderr.startswith((b"\r\n", b"#< CLIXML\r\n", b"<# CLIXML\r\n"), next_root):
+                if stderr.startswith(b"\r\n", next_root):
+                    next_root += 2
+                elif stderr.startswith(b"#< CLIXML\r\n", next_root):
+                    next_root += len(b"#< CLIXML\r\n")
+                else:
+                    next_root += len(b"<# CLIXML\r\n")
+            if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs", next_root):
+                break
+            next_close = stderr.find(closing_tag, next_root)
+            if next_close == -1:
+                block_end = -1
+                break
+            block_end = next_close + len(closing_tag)
+
+        if block_end == -1:
+            break
+
+        encoded_block = stderr[block_start:block_end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                clixml_text = encoded_block.decode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                clixml_text = encoded_block.decode("cp437")
+            decoded = _parse_clixml(clixml_text.encode("utf-8"))
+        except Exception:
+            # Keep malformed CLIXML exactly as it appeared and keep looking for
+            # any later independent CLIXML block.
+            search_offset = block_end
+            continue
+
+        output.extend(stderr[offset:block_start])
+        output.extend(decoded)
+        offset = block_end
+        search_offset = block_end
+        changed = True
+
+    if not changed:
+        return stderr
+
+    output.extend(stderr[offset:])
+    return bytes(output)
+
